Director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`). The seat prepared this closure as its own sweep and the runtime's write policy refused the 90-card batch; per the maintainer's words above it is the triage seat's act — triage is the charter's producer of closures and `not_planned` reasons. `pm:retriage` on this card is the summons; the seat post (#6015) carries the accelerator comment.

## The order

For each card below, **in this order per card**, ⛔ re-reading the card's current state first (any list snapshot is void): skip the card if it is not open, has an assignee, carries any pm-state other than exactly `pm:queue`, carries `pm:retriage`, or has an open PR referencing it — and list every skip with its reason in the completion comment here. Otherwise: (1) post the closing comment below through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`; (2) `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --remove pm:queue` (four-step, read back); (3) close with `state_reason: not_planned`. Log `#N → closed` per card; when done, post the log here and close this card `completed`.

### Closing comment (post verbatim, with the executing seat's session id in place of the director's)

```
Closed `not_planned` by the director seat (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`), <UTC of the closing act>, under ruling batch #202 letter **B** (maintainer, in chat: 「B(荐)A + 清理存量」, amended in the same exchange from 「p2 转 pm:on-hold」 to close — 「卡片只要 open 就要一直被扫描」).

**Why**: this card is tooling / gate / process work with no customer-visible pull. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈优先级〉 rule 2 (「不在路上、不在清单上 ⇒ p3 或不做」) and rule 3 (「产品 P0/P1 开着时不做 p2/p3 工具卡」 — objectstack carries 3 product P0 and 29 product P1 cards open today), plus the maintainer's standing principles 「不希望一直开发门禁」 and 「零拉动默认 defer 或 remove」. Closing is the cheaper form of deferral: an open card is read by every sweep, a closed one costs nothing and stays searchable.

**Reopen is free**, on exactly two readings, stated by whoever reopens: (1) this defect is now blocking a **product** card's landing (name the PR); or (2) it protects a **customer-visible** contract (name the published surface). ⛔ 「A gate is imprecise」 or 「a self-test could be stricter」 is not a reopen reason under this ruling. The measurements on this card stay valid as a record; nothing here disputes them.
```
